text:
maria: Quick sketch — proposing a "Gradual failover preview" in Console: a sandbox where you can dry-run an automatic fallback policy against sampled traffic and see estimated routing %, cost delta, and an audit breadcrumb log. Thoughts?

leo: love the idea. can we surface the top contributing signals (latency/errors) that drove the simulation?

maria: yes — plan is to show ranked signals + heatmap. also add an option to toggle quota-awareness so the sim respects reservation limits.

aj: how does operator override work in the sim? sticky override vs ephemeral?

maria: good q. proposal: two modes — "preview-only" (no real traffic) and "preview+apply" (apply when you confirm). operator override in preview should be ephemeral and recorded in audit only; if applied it becomes sticky and creates an explicit change event.

opsbot: deploy-bot: note — any applied preview should create an immutable audit entry with who/when/reason. automate webhook to compliance if enterprise tenant enabled.

kevin: we need reason codes in telemetry. when a request falls back in sim or real, attach a decision_code like `sim_error_rate_trigger` or `hard_quarantine`. helps downstream evals.

sara: UX nit: show a single-number fidelity score for the sim (how representative the sample is) and a small CTA to re-run with different sample windows.

maria: agree. also want a tiny timeline slider to simulate ramping: 0 -> 50% over X mins. quick config snippet i'm thinking: ```yaml
policy:
  mode: gradual
  primary: redwood/llama-70b
  fallback: redwood/llama-7b-quant
  trigger: error_rate > 0.03 or latency_p95 > 800ms
  ramp: 10%/min
  sample_window: 10m
  quota_aware: true
```

leo: UI suggestion — show predicted token-cost delta as a sparkline and an alert if predicted cost exceeds budget. link to Dedicated quota if applicable.

aj: also include a read-only diff view of the policy change (before / after) so SREs can approve. maybe tie to rollouts: create a canary from the sim.

maria: yep — create canary action that exports the sim config into a rollout. default to monitor-only for 15m.

kevin: about audit breadcrumbs — we should store the full decision trace (signals, weights, evaluated thresholds) for each simulated decision but sample at 1% for storage reasons. include a "replay" button that replays decisions on a shaded timeline.

opsbot: compliance-bot: remember retention defaults differ by tier. enterprise customers want 1y immutable retention — flag if sim contains customer data.

sara: question on error triggers: do we allow boolean combos (AND/OR) in the UI or only simple thresholds? complex combos are useful but scary for non-experts.

maria: plan to support a simple visual builder with groups (all/any) + advanced YAML editor for power users. default to safe presets: soft-degrade (sample), quiet-cut (no user-visible change), hard-cut.

leo: can we add a small "what-if" card that shows user-visible impact (latency change, hallucination rate estimate) so PMs can quickly understand UX tradeoffs?

maria: will prototype cards. final question for the group: are we comfortable with an "apply from preview" button in the Console with two confirmations (apply + create audit entry)? or do we gate apply behind RBAC?

aj: definitely RBAC gated. also require a short reason field on apply.

kevin: +1 RBAC. and add an optional automation hook so infra can automatically create a ticket when somebody applies a preview to prod.

maria: great feedback — i'll update the mock and add a small interaction doc. if anyone wants to pair on the audit schema or sample retention rules ping me. :raised_hands:
